### Myocardial infarction codelist

This codelist includes codes identifying an acute, recurrent, silent, or otherwise diagnosed myocardial infarction. It excludes codes that indicate only a past/history of MI, an ECG finding of old MI, or a complication following MI.

| Code system / group | Codes | Terms represented |
|---|---|---|
| Read — acute, unspecified, or general MI | `G30`, `G30-1`, `G30-4`, `G30-5`, `G30-7`, `G30-99`, `G30z`, `G30y`, `G30yz`, `G30-7` | Acute MI; heart attack; MI; silent MI; other or unspecified acute MI |
| Read — acute MI by site/type | `G300`, `G301`, `G3010`, `G3011`, `G301z`, `G302`, `G303`, `G304`, `G305`, `G306`, `G307`, `G3070`, `G3071`, `G308`, `G309`, `G30B`, `G30X`, `G30X0`, `G30y0`, `G30y1`, `G30y2`, `Gyu34` | Acute MI by wall or site; Q-wave, non-Q-wave, STEMI, NSTEMI, transmural, or other specified MI |
| Read — recurrent/subsequent MI | `G35`, `G350`, `G351`, `G353`, `G35X`, `Gyu35`, `Gyu36` | Subsequent MI, including specified or unspecified site |
| Read — MI with complication / postoperative MI | `G36`, `G38`, `G380`, `G381`, `G382`, `G383`, `G384`, `G38z` | MI with complication; postoperative MI, including specified types or sites |

### Myocardial infarction codelist

This codelist includes codes identifying an acute, recurrent, silent, or otherwise diagnosed myocardial infarction. It excludes codes that indicate only a past/history of MI, an ECG finding of old MI, or a complication following MI.

| Code system / group | Codes | Terms represented |
|---|---|---|
| Read — acute, unspecified, or general MI | `G30`, `G30-1`, `G30-4`, `G30-5`, `G30-7`, `G30-99`, `G30z`, `G30y`, `G30yz`, `G30-7` | Acute MI; heart attack; MI; silent MI; other or unspecified acute MI |
| Read — acute MI by site/type | `G300`, `G301`, `G3010`, `G3011`, `G301z`, `G302`, `G303`, `G304`, `G305`, `G306`, `G307`, `G3070`, `G3071`, `G308`, `G309`, `G30B`, `G30X`, `G30X0`, `G30y0`, `G30y1`, `G30y2`, `Gyu34` | Acute MI by wall or site; Q-wave, non-Q-wave, STEMI, NSTEMI, transmural, or other specified MI |
| Read — recurrent/subsequent MI | `G35`, `G350`, `G351`, `G353`, `G35X`, `Gyu35`, `Gyu36` | Subsequent MI, including specified or unspecified site |
| Read — MI with complication / postoperative MI | `G36`, `G38`, `G380`, `G381`, `G382`, `G383`, `G384`, `G38z` | MI with complication; postoperative MI, including specified types or sites |
